Specification: This module is a TLC model-checking wrapper for the write-through cache specification from LiveWriteThroughCache. It manually instantiates definitions corresponding to the internal-memory liveness specification, using a refinement mapping from the cache implementation state variables to abstract memory variables omem, octl, and obuf, because the comments explain that the TLC version targeted here cannot handle the intended INSTANCE-based instantiation directly. The file defines initial-state, next-state, type-invariant, enabledness, liveness, and combined specification formulas for the instantiated internal memory view, and also includes constants and a PostCondition value describing a counterexample-shaped structure for model checking.
